oncall-bot: PAGED: host-runtime-prod-eu-west KV cache OOM surge (multiple pods). Alertgroup: kvcache-oom-high. Symptoms: rapid kv_entry growth after large single-request contexts. Context: hosted runtime, continuous-batching enabled, prefetch=on.

Samir Patel: got the page, investigating. marking as P1. Looking at pod logs now.

Tess Nguyen: I see a correlated spike in continuous-batching windows — average batch window went from ~12ms to 220ms followed by kv.entry_count growth. Might be prefetch pulling huge prefixes for long prompts.

Jin Park: checking recent rollouts — we pushed kvcache-prefetch v2 to hosted last night (canary->prod). Rollback possible.

Samir Patel: can we throttle prefetch at runtime? Any feature flag?

Tess Nguyen: yes, there is a runtime flag: runtime.kv_prefetch.enabled and runtime.kv_prefetch.max_prefetch_tokens. Current values: enabled=true, max_prefetch_tokens=20000 (oops). Recommend set max_prefetch_tokens=2048 and enabled=false on affected pool as hotfix.

Samir Patel: doing hotfix:
```bash
# patch runtime config for pool hosted-eu-west-1
curl -X POST https://admin.redwood.internal/pools/hosted-eu-west-1/config
  -H 'Authorization: Bearer $ADMIN_TOKEN'
  -d '{"runtime.kv_prefetch.enabled": false, "runtime.kv_prefetch.max_prefetch_tokens": 2048}'
```

deploy-bot: config-change accepted; rolling config to 6 pods. change_id=cfg-20260315-01.

Samir Patel: monitoring memory after patch.

Priya Gomez: heads up — we have a high-volume customer hitting long-chat transcripts (ACME Corp). CS is on standby to throttle their traffic if needed.

Riley Chen: oncall handoff incoming in 45m, ping me if you want a full handoff. I'll take the night if it doesn't get resolved.

Jin Park: also throttling continuous-batch window server-side is possible: set batching.max_window_ms=100. Current is 1000ms in that pool. Should reduce KV cache blowups. Proposing to set to 200ms for immediate safety.

Samir Patel: applying batch throttle now.
```bash
curl -X POST https://admin.redwood.internal/pools/hosted-eu-west-1/config
  -H 'Authorization: Bearer $ADMIN_TOKEN'
  -d '{"batching.max_window_ms": 200}'
```

deploy-bot: config-change accepted; rolling to 6 pods. change_id=cfg-20260315-02.

Tess Nguyen: observed immediate flattening of kv.entry_count growth on 3 pods. Memory GC spikes reduced. Good sign.

Samir Patel: memory usage graphs: before hotfix pods hitting >92% RSS, after hotfix avg RSS ~58%. Eviction events stopped.

Samir Patel: root cause suspicion: prefetch v2 had a bug where it mistakenly treated system-delimited prompts as single-token anchors and expanded prefetch to full context length for some messages (long single-user uploads). Combined with continuous-batching long windows -> KV entries accumulate.

Jin Park: creating follow-up: revert prefetch v2 until we patch. I'll open a rollback PR and schedule a safer rollout with limits.

Priya Gomez: CS: notifying affected customers (ACME + 2 smaller tenants). Message draft: "We observed elevated latencies and transient memory errors affecting hosted runtime during long-context requests. We've applied throttles and a hotfix; service is stabilizing. We're following up with root cause and timeline." Approve?

Samir Patel: approve. Add note to include mitigation steps and ETA for permanent fix (24-48h).

Riley Chen: quick risk checklist for handoff: 1) hotfix applied? yes. 2) rollback queued? yes, Jin PR. 3) CS notified? yes. 4) watchlist: increase in queued requests or new prefetch rollouts. I'll take ownership at 1776003300.

Tess Nguyen: postmortem items: add circuit-breaker for prefetch, enforce max_prefetch_tokens <= 4096 by config validator, and add a regression eval for long single-prompt uploads.

Samir Patel: marking thread resolved for active paging. We'll keep monitoring for 2 hours before closing incident. If memory climbs again, escalate to infra SRE.

oncall-bot: INCIDENT UPDATE: status=stabilized. active_alerts=0. impacted_customers=["ACME Corp", "small-tenant-17", "test-shop-9"]. next_check=10m.

Jin Park: PR opened for rollback: https://git.internal/r/redwood/kvcache/merge/782. Assigned @Tess.

Priya Gomez: CS update sent at 1776001380: customers acknowledged; ACME requested rate-limiting guidance.

Samir Patel: thanks all. Riley, I'll DM you the live dashboards and playbook before handoff.

Riley Chen: copy. standing by. :thumbsup:

deploy-bot: rolling-change complete for cfg-20260315-01 and cfg-20260315-02.

Samir Patel: final note: don't re-enable prefetch globally until validated on canary with strict token caps.

oncall-bot: THREAD CLOSED: resolved_by=Samir Patel, resolution_summary="prefetch throttled + batch window reduced; memory stabilized; rollback PR created". close_ts=1776001500
